checkout.description: Fallback local clone path lasius operates on when the mutate.requested payload omits `checkout`. The route node stats <checkout>/<package>/stryker.conf.json, so a real path is required. REQUIRED per deployment or per request.

lasius_root.description: lasius workspace root (--root flag); repo args are checkout paths so any lasius.toml workspace works.

worktree_base.description: Worktrees land at <worktree_base>/wt-<id>; request env files, mutant summaries and report copies live under <worktree_base>/{requests,reports}.

node_url.description: Base URL of `peregrin serve` (sessions plane). The agent node POSTs /api/sessions/run here; bearer = PEREGRIN_TOKEN.

install_cmd.description: Dependency install run at the worktree root before mutation. Default suits bun monorepos (ktbhealth/product); override per repo (npm/pnpm/cargo …).

mutate_cmd.description: Mutation command run with cwd=<worktree>/<package>. MUST exit 0 on a completed run — do not set a thresholds.break value in the repo's stryker.conf.json. Default `bun run mutate` matches the per-package `"mutate": "stryker run"` script convention.

mutate_report.description: Stryker jsonReporter output path, relative to the package dir. The node requires this file to exist and parse as JSON after mutate_cmd exits 0.

actionable_statuses.description: JSON array of mutant statuses handed to the agent. Default Survived/Timeout/NoCoverage; Ignored is deliberate and CompileError/RuntimeError are harness problems.

summary_max_lines.description: Cap on actionable-mutant lines written into the agent prompt summary; the full detail file is kept under <worktree_base>/reports regardless.

branch_prefix.description: Head-branch prefix — the pushed branch is <branch_prefix>/<id>. Convention: id like "<pkg>-mutation" yields test/<pkg>-mutation.

default_branch.description: Fallback PR base / worktree rev when the payload omits `base_branch`.

agent.description: sepia agent-config id for the triage session.

agent_mode.description: ACP session mode applied after create (session/set_mode). REQUIRED for unattended runs — devin's default accept-edits prompts on exec and deadlocks. 'bypass' auto-approves all tools; 'smart' is the safer middle ground.

agent_timeout_ms.description: Agent session timeout in ms (default 30 min — whole-package mutant triage is long). curl --max-time derives from it (+100s); the node's own timeout ceiling is ~66 min, so keep values under ~3600000.
